comment: The Welcome picture follows the hour the window opens at. Run with SARA_WELCOME_PICTURES=res://ui/welcome/tests/pictures/ and SARA_WELCOME_HOUR=<hour>, which is the suite's two plain pictures, a blue morning at 6 and a red evening at 18 with a disc each side, at a clock fixed between them: at 6 only the morning, at 12 both discs half there, at 18 only the evening. Then the window is put away and shown again, which reads the hour again.
